verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own REST API for retrieving transactions, cards, users and invoices programmatically. A reconciliation guide also describes pulling all transactions for a billing period and exporting them to an accounting system, and the API is described by an open OpenAPI 3.1 schema. That gives a real API-based path to get core data out in machine-readable form, but nothing documents a complete account export, open-format file downloads, or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export, explicit open file formats (CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types beyond transactions, account-closure/portability guidance, and independent corroboration.
